messages.subject: [Jobad] PhD position Ghent University (Belgium)
parts:
(apologies for cross posting)

Dear all,

We are advertising a fully funded PhD position at Ghent University on
methodological developments in structural equation modeling, with a focus on
combining latent variables and composites.

The project is hosted at the Department of Data Analysis, embedded in
the SEM research group, and is funded by the Research Foundation –
Flanders (FWO).

The position is suitable for candidates with a strong background in
statistics, psychometrics, and R.

The full job description and application details can be found here:

https://www.ugent.be/en/work/scientific/doctoral-fellow-45

We would greatly appreciate it if you could share this announcement with
anyone who might be interested.

Yves Rosseel
Tamara Schamberger.

--
Yves Rosseel
Department of Data Analysis, Ghent University
